lines.en: Which is why she was out here — waiting for her beloved senpai to return from his heated closet of debauchery so she could confront {i}him{/i} without traumatizing her student slash good friend’s daughter.
lines.zh: 所以她才会站在外面——等她敬爱的学长从他那间燥热的淫靡储藏室里出来，好在不吓到自己学生兼挚友的女儿的前提下跟{i}他{/i}对质。

lines.en: {size=-4}And while she’d known for quite some time that such a thing was {i}possible{/i} given the nature of these girls and the man they encircle as if he were the sun, she’d tried her best to deceive herself into believing otherwise.{/size}

lines.en: It was a tactic she perfected the night she was scarred for life — something that may have {i}saved{/i} said life when all was said and done after hours and hours of her attackers saying and doing things.
lines.zh: 这是她在那个被吓出心理阴影的夜晚里练到炉火纯青的招数——在袭击者说了、做了那么多事之后，说不定正是这招{i}救了{/i}她一命。

lines.en: Tonight, she’d save {i}another{/i} life, though. It was her turn to finally make a difference and be the angel she prayed for back when she still believed that praying made a difference.
lines.zh: 不过今晚，她要救的是{i}另一条{/i}命。终于轮到她发挥作用、成为她当年还相信祈祷有用时祈求过的那个天使了。
